title: How to Create an Annotated Bibliography — MLA
skills: format an annotated bibliography using MLA conventions
construct source citations for an annotated bibliography
organize research sources with clear annotations and attribution
alignment_note: Demonstrates how to create an annotated bibliography using MLA-style citation and annotation conventions. Supports research organization, source evaluation, academic writing, citation practice, and responsible evidence use across high school English courses. Students should verify formatting details against the current MLA edition when completing formal assignments.
